abstract: An animal model of experimental testicular teratoma has been established to study how a teratoma affects the host testis and how the host testis reacts against the teratoma. 129/SvJ-mice were used as experimental animals. To induce the experimental testicular teratoma, male gonadal ridges from 12-day-old 129/SvJ-mouse fetuses were grafted into the testes of adult mice for 1-12 weeks. The developing tumour was analysed by light and electron microscopy and by immunocytochemical localization of transcription factors SOX9 and c-kit, glial fibrillary acidic protein (GFAP) and type IV collagen. Testicular teratoma was observed in 36 out of 124 testes with implanted fetal gonadal ridges (frequency 29%). One spontaneous testicular teratoma was observed in this material from 70 male mice (1.5%). One week after implantation intracordal clusters of cells were seen in embryonic testicular cords of the graft as the first sign of testicular teratomas. Four weeks after implantation the embryonic testicular cords had totally disappeared from grafts with teratomas, and the tumour tissue had enlarged the testis and invaded the interstitium of the host testis. It consisted of solitary pieces of immature cartilage as well as of glial cells and of primitive neuroepithelium. Six to eight weeks after implantation the tumour tissue had expanded so that the enlarged testis could be detected by macroscopic enlargement of the scrotum. The testicular tissue of the host had practically disappeared, and only solitary disrupted seminiferous tubules of the host were seen surrounding the teratoma. Neuroepithelial structures of some teratomas cultured for 8 weeks had cells with a granular nucleus as a sign of obvious apoptosis. Eleven to 12 weeks after implantation the growth of the teratoma had stopped, and the histology corresponded to that of a mature cystic teratoma. GFAP, SOX9 and type IV collagen were strongly positive in some parts of the tumours cultured for 4 and 8 weeks, while only occasional c-kit-positive areas were observed in tumours cultured for 8 weeks. As conclusions: (1) the metastasizing capacity of the experimental testicular teratoma is very low during 12 weeks, but the behaviour of the tumour in the testicular tissue of the graft is invasive; (2) the growth of experimental testicular teratomas cease 6-8 weeks after implantation of the fetal gonadal ridges with the obvious apoptosis of the immature tissue components; (3) the model of experimental testicular teratoma in the mouse is suitable for studying how the teratoma affects the host testis and how the host testis reacts to teratoma.
abstract_ja:
実験的精巣奇形腫のモデルは、奇形腫が宿主精巣に及ぼす影響と、宿主精巣が奇形腫にどのように反応するかを研究するために作製された。実験動物として129/SvJマウスを用いた。実験的精巣奇形腫を誘導するため、12日齢の129/SvJマウス胎仔から雄の生殖隆起を採取し、成体マウスの精巣に1～12週間移植した。増殖した腫瘍を光学顕微鏡および電子顕微鏡で解析し、転写因子SOX9およびc-kit、グリア線維性酸性蛋白（GFAP）、IV型コラーゲンの免疫細胞化学的局在を検討した。
精巣奇形腫は、胎生期精巣組織を移植した124個の精巣のうち36個（頻度29%）で認められた。この材料の雄マウス70匹のうち、自然発生の精巣奇形腫は1個（1.5%）に認められた。移植後1週間で、移植片の胎生期精巣索内に、奇形腫の最初の兆候として細胞集塊が認められた。移植後4週で、奇形腫を有する移植片では胎生期精巣索は完全に消失し、腫瘍組織は精巣を拡大させ、宿主精巣の間質へ浸潤していた。腫瘍組織は、未熟な軟骨の小片のほか、グリア細胞および原始的な神経上皮からなっていた。移植後6～8週では、腫瘍組織が拡大して精巣の腫大が陰嚢の拡大として肉眼的に確認できた。宿主の精巣組織はほぼ消失し、奇形腫の周囲に、断片化した宿主の精細管がわずかに残るのみであった。8週間培養した奇形腫の一部の神経上皮構造では、顆粒状の核を持つ細胞が認められ、明らかなアポトーシスを示していた。移植後11～12週では奇形腫の増殖は停止し、組織像は成熟嚢胞性奇形腫に一致した。
結論として、(1) 実験的精巣奇形腫の転移能は12週間にわたり非常に低いが、移植片の精巣内での挙動は浸潤性である。(2) 腫瘍の増殖は、胎生期生殖隆起の移植後6～8週で停止し、未熟組織成分に明らかなアポトーシスが認められる。(3) マウスの実験的精巣奇形腫モデルは、奇形腫が宿主精巣に及ぼす影響と、宿主精巣が奇形腫にどのように反応するかを研究するのに適している。
